messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Grant <alex.grant@curiohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Curio Health — Go-live readiness & owner map

Team —

Quick handoff: Curio Health (signed today) is planning a phased go-live with Redwood Dedicated in Q1. I wanted to capture context, risks, and proposed owners so CS and PMs can pick up orchestration. Summary bullets below; full MAP attached.

Deal context:
- ARR: $480k (annual committed Dedicated capacity + Optimize add-on)
- Primary deployment: Redwood Dedicated (us-west region), customer requires dedicated v1 cluster with private peering and SOC2 evidence
- Expected peak traffic: 60 rps across 8 routes; median seq len ~512, up to 2k tokens for batch jobs
- Critical SLOs: 95th pct latency <= 220ms for rt routes; 99.5% availability SLA in contract

Key integration notes / risks:
- Curio will use our streaming chat + function-calling for document ingestion pipelines — they will push embeddings and long-form generation for care summaries. Embed volume in first 30 days estimated ~3M tokens/day.
- They need KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and audit log exports to their SIEM. Engineering says KMS onboarding can take 2–3 weeks with their security team.
- API rate limits: we will provision burst capacity but they requested reserved headroom for holiday spikes. Ops needs to validate autoscale policy and add burst GPU allocation.
- Model selection: recommending an m7-like open variant with int8 quantization for cost; will plan a canary to the higher-fidelity variant for the Summaries route.

Proposed owners / immediate asks:
- CS owner (post-sale): Laura Bennett — lead for onboarding, customer success plan, and weekly playbooks.
- Implementation PM: Tessa Morgan — sprint planning, runbook signoff, and go/no-go checklist.
- Escalation / infra lead: Vivek Kulkarni — region capacity, Dedicated pool sizing, and SLA ops.

Next steps (this week):
1) Laura — schedule 60m kickoff with Curio + engineering owners (include security lead) — target by Fri 12/10.
2) Tessa — draft 4-week sprint plan and list of required Redwood infra changes (KMS, audit-export config, burst policy).
3) Vivek — confirm initial Dedicated cluster size and estimated ramp costs; flag anything that requires an infra exception.
4) Ben — I will upload signed SOW and MAP to Drive and update HubSpot (deal RDW-2027-CH-8472).

Attachments: [Curio_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 248KB)], [Mutual_Action_Plan_Curio.xlsx (XLSX, 56KB)]

Ben

Thanks — copying notes into a CS intake doc and starting the playbook. Quick clarifying Qs before I schedule kickoff:

- KMS: do we have their KMS provider (AWS KMS vs. external HSM)? Ben, can you confirm vendor + contact?
- SIEM export cadence: they asked for near-real-time exports. Is the contract requiring streaming logs or batched exports?
- Can we get a short list of the 8 routes and which are latency-critical vs batch so we can set SLOs per route?

I'll propose two slots for kickoff (Fri 12/10 10:00–11:00 PT or Mon 12/13 09:00–10:00 PT). If they need earlier, we'll find an interim sync with their technical lead.

Tessa — when you draft the 4-week sprint plan, include owner for integration testing and a dry-run for failover (region fallback). Vivek — please pre-approve the initial Dedicated pool sizing so procurement can provision.

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben & Laura — excited to kick this off. Confirming a couple items from our side:

- KMS: Curio uses AWS KMS with a customer-managed CMK; security will want an architecture diagram and a short checklist for key rotation implications.
- SIEM: we need near-real-time log streaming into Splunk. Is Redwood able to ship streaming audit events to an external HTTP collector or do we need a partner connector?
- Integration owner: Sam Park (cc'd) will own server-side integration and will be on the kickoff call.

Kickoff: Fri 12/10 10:00–11:00 PT works for our engineering and security teams. Please send calendar invite + Zoom link.

- CS lead: Laura Bennett — onboarding plan, playbook, weekly success metrics (OKRs).
- Implementation PM: Tessa Morgan — sprint plan, runbooks, acceptance criteria.
- Infra & SLA ops: Vivek Kulkarni — Dedicated sizing, autoscale/burst policy, and post-go-live incident runbook.

Action items attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_Curio.xlsx outlines week-by-week owners and acceptance criteria. I've also uploaded the signed SOW (Curio_SOW_v2.pdf) to Drive and updated HubSpot.

Risks / blocking items (owner):
- KMS gating (Alex / Curio) — need CMK info + security diagram by kickoff or security may require a separate onboarding window.
- SIEM streaming (Vivek / Eng) — confirm whether we can push streaming audit events to their Splunk collector or whether an interim S3/batched export is needed.
- Capacity billing note (Ben) — procurement approved burst reserve but finance needs final usage estimate by end of Q1.

If no objections, Laura will run the kickoff and Tessa will send the sprint doc within 48 hours.

Account Executive, Redwood Inference
